author: The Current
description:
The Format's Nate Ruess and Sam Means interview with The Current's Jill Riley
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

The Format's Nate Ruess talks about how he learned to play guitar much later in life — in fact, just over the past few years. "I figured it out enough to, like, write an album," Ruess says.

The result is The Format's new album, "Boycott Heaven," releasing January 23, 2026.
